**1.004: switch your remote's buttons off without losing them, Clear all, and saved sets of bindings.**

- **Use bound buttons** (Settings → Sound, microphone and buttons → Buttons): turn it off and Hebrish takes no keys, so the same Bluetooth remote works in other apps. Your bindings are kept for when you turn it back on.
- **Clear all** removes every binding at once.
- **Saved sets:** give the current bindings a name and tap **Save**, for example one set per remote; **Use** switches to a set, **Delete** removes it. Saved on your phone.
- Not yet tested on a phone. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
